examples.question_text: Calculate the simple interest on $\$13\,500$ at $5.5\%$ p.a. for $6$ months.
Calculate the total owing after $2$ years if $\$3000$ is borrowed at $12\%$ p.a. simple interest.

(a) An investment of $\$3300$ at $7\%$ p.a. simple interest earns $\$1386$ in interest. Find the time in years.
(b) An investment at $3\%$ p.a. simple interest for $8$ years earns $\$279.60$ in interest. Find the principal.
(c) An investment of $\$5000$ earns $\$150$ in simple interest over $2$ years. Find the annual interest rate as a percentage.
An investment grows from $\$3600$ to $\$4464$ at $6\%$ p.a. simple interest. Find the interest earned and the time in years.
Calculate the total value of an investment of $\$2400$ after $1$ year and $7$ months at $4.5\%$ p.a. simple interest.
examples.solution_text:
Use years because the rate is per annum.
$\begin{align*}n &= 1 + \frac{7}{12} \\ n &= \frac{19}{12}\text{ years}\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}I &= Prn \\ I &= \$2400 \times 0.045 \times \frac{19}{12} \\ I &= \$171\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}A &= P + I \\ A &= \$2400 + \$171 \\ A &= \$2571.00\end{align*}$

examples.question_text:
(a) An investment of $\$6000$ at $4\%$ p.a. simple interest earns $\$360$ in interest. Find the time in months.
(b) An investment at $6\%$ p.a. simple interest earns $\$425$ in interest over $10$ months. Find the principal.
(c) An investment of $\$4800$ earns $\$540$ in simple interest over $30$ months. Find the annual interest rate as a percentage.
examples.solution_text:
(a)
$\begin{align*}I &= Prn \\ \$360 &= \$6000 \times 0.04 \times n \\ \$360 &= \$240 \times n \\ n &= \frac{360}{240} \\ n &= 1.5\text{ years}\end{align*}$
Convert years to months.
$\begin{align*}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}1.5 \times 12 \\ &= 18\text{ months}\end{align*}$
(b)
$n = \frac{10}{12}\text{ years}$
$\begin{align*}I &= Prn \\ \$425 &= P \times 0.06 \times \frac{10}{12} \\ \$425 &= P \times 0.05 \\ P &= \frac{425}{0.05} \\ P &= \$8500.00\end{align*}$
(c)
$\begin{align*}n &= \frac{30}{12} \\ n &= 2.5\text{ years}\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}I &= Prn \\ \$540 &= \$4800 \times r \times 2.5 \\ \$540 &= \$12\,000 \times r \\ r &= \frac{540}{12\,000} \\ r &= 0.045\end{align*}$
Multiply the decimal rate by $100$ to express it as a percentage.
$\begin{align*}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}0.045 \times 100\% \\ &= 4.5\%\end{align*}$
The annual interest rate is $4.5\%$ p.a.

examples.question_text: An investment of $\$8000$ grows to $\$9200$ after $4$ years. Find the annual simple interest rate as a percentage.
examples.solution_text:
Find the interest before substituting into the formula.
$\begin{align*}I &= A - P \\ I &= \$9200 - \$8000 \\ I &= \$1200\end{align*}$
$\begin{align*}I &= Prn \\ \$1200 &= \$8000 \times r \times 4 \\ \$1200 &= \$32\,000 \times r \\ r &= \frac{1200}{32\,000} \\ r &= 0.0375\end{align*}$
Multiply the decimal rate by $100$ to express it as a percentage.
$\begin{align*}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}0.0375 \times 100\% \\ &= 3.75\%\end{align*}$
The annual interest rate is $3.75\%$ p.a.
